wiki.title: Necrowart Zombie
wiki.text:
Were you looking for the pet pal?

The Necrowart Zombie is an enemy NPC that can be found mainly in Briarwood. It's appearance isn't much to be desired as they walk on all fours, frequently wheeze, are somewhat purple in pigmentation and have a mushroom growing out of their back.

Battle
Necrowart Zombies are mainly found wandering near the stream in Bristlewood, Briarwood and require a level 9 combat job to encounter. They also feature in some dungeons such as the Haunted Mines in Blackspore Swamp (which requires a level 13 combat job to enter) except they are referred to as Shamblers and do not have a mushroom growing out of their back. They also feature at Super Spooktacular when the Pumpkin Prince arrives. Sometimes the Pumpkin Prince will spawn a spawner which will spawn hostiles such as Grave Elementals and Necrowart Zombies.

Also if you own a level 11 or above farm you can purchase a fungus sprayer from the vending machine on your farm. This enables you to turn yourself and others into necrowart zombies. Also at Halloween if you are attacked by the Pumpkin Prince then a chance that you will turn into a necrowart zombie and lose your ectoplasmic shooter and will have to pick up another one once the effect has worn out.
